title: Guardia Civil: 28 arrested, four investigated over cyberscams exceeding 112.000 euros in Cantabria
date_note: Crónica de Cantabria's page shows no publication day; 24 November is the day of the announcement according to the feed and the page's upload path.
place: Cantabria, Spain (arrests in Barcelona and Girona)
geo_basis: region of the victims, as the source states; the arrests were in Barcelona and Girona
summary: Crónica de Cantabria reports that the Guardia Civil of Cantabria, in 'operación Bargero 2026', arrested 28 people and placed 4 under investigation for cyberscams that 'superan los 112.000 euros'. According to the report, the arrests were in Barcelona and Girona. The scams included fake bank SMS followed by calls, fake crypto investments and WhatsApp impersonation of relatives.
plain: Spain's Guardia Civil in Cantabria arrested 28 people and is investigating 4 more over online scams exceeding 112.000 euros, according to a local news report.
exec: Crónica de Cantabria reports the Guardia Civil arrested 28 people over bank-impersonation, fake-investment and WhatsApp scams.

evidence.quote: Detenidas 28 personas e investigadas cuatro por ciberestafas en Cantabria que superan los 112.000 euros
